specimenNotice: Synthetic VF1 experiment. Assessment judgments are supplied by the local host reasoning session.

risk.rationale: Selection state and cache reuse can show wrong or empty catalog pages across requests. The public synthetic fixture runs in one local process and can be reverted locally.

criteria.scopeDescription: Exact nonempty category matching in list_items on the offered catalog. Exercise membership, filtered count and a case variant.

obligations.description: Return only the two tools rows and their filtered total for the exact category.
Return a filtered total of zero for Tools, whose case differs from the stored category.

comparisonContexts.description: Request tools and Tools at page 1 with size 2.

criteria.scopeDescription: Selecting tools from books must leave the view on page 1 and use page 1 in the API call. The page-1 baseline and page-3 transition exercise distinct starting states.

obligations.description: The view must show page 1 after selection from either initial state.
When selecting tools from page 3, send page 1 at the API boundary.

comparisonContexts.description: Select tools from the default view at page 1 and inspect resulting state and items.
Select tools from a books view starting at page 3.

criteria.scopeDescription: On one CatalogAPI instance the full request tuple must select the right result. Compare an identical request, a category-only change, and page or size changes within one category.

obligations.description: Serve the same correct tools IDs on repeating a tuple.
Serve the newly requested category when page and size are unchanged.
Serve the proper slice when page alone or size alone changes.

comparisonContexts.description: Repeat tools, page 1, default size on a fresh instance.
Reuse one instance for books then tools with page 1 and size 2.
Reuse one instance for three books requests that vary page and size. The source specifies assertions but the offered observations omit this test.

criteria.scopeDescription: Fixed-category pagination on the synthetic catalog. Compare ordered, bounded slices against the catalog at multiple pages and sizes, and check an empty out-of-range result with the filtered total. Execute the fixed-category API page/size sequence to supply the required integration proof. Direct out-of-range API verification would complement the observed service check.

obligations.description: Return catalog-order slices bounded by the requested size at the fixed-category service/API boundary.
Return empty items with the filtered total even past the last page at the service/API boundary.

comparisonContexts.description: For books compare pages 1 and 2 at size 2 and page 1 at size 1. The offered integration test source specifies these comparisons. The service test separately exercises the page-2 slice.
For tools page 3 at size 2 check empty items and filtered total 2. The offered unit test executes this boundary at the service.

evidenceReviews.rationale: Collector unit pass at the job's pinned revision for Baseline.test_service_category_and_case. Its three assertions cover matching tools IDs, filtered count and a count of zero for Tools.
Collector unit pass at the pinned revision for Baseline.test_service_pagination_and_out_of_range. It checks B3/B4 for books page 2 and the full service result for tools page 3.
Collector integration pass at the pinned revision for Baseline.test_api_repeat_same_request. It checks the IDs of both same-tuple responses and the number of cache entries.
Collector integration pass at the pinned revision for Baseline.test_ui_select_from_first_page. It checks category, page and tools IDs from the default page.
Collector integration failure at the pinned revision for Historical.test_reset_from_third_page. Its first assertion observed view.page equal to 3. The later result-items assertion was not reached.
Collector integration failure at the pinned revision for Probe.test_reset_with_recorded_api_call. The recorded call used tools, page 3, size 2.
Collector integration failure at the pinned revision for Probe.test_cache_across_categories. The second response repeated the books IDs. Execution stopped before the total assertion.

bindings.rationale: The tools request returned T1 and T2 with filtered total 2 as asserted.
The separate Tools request in the same passing unit check produced filtered total 0.
Starting on page 1, the view selected tools, remained on page 1 and returned the first two tools IDs.
After selecting tools from page 3, the view.page assertion expected 1 and observed 3. Reset the page on selection.
The recording API observed ('tools', 3, 2) where the check required ('tools', 1, 2). Reset the stored page before issuing get_items.
Both tools requests returned T1/T2 and the cache contained one entry.
The books request returned B1/B2. The next request for tools returned B1/B2 instead of T1/T2. Include category in the lookup key and rerun the sequence. The tools total assertion was not reached.
The unit observation checks the books page-2 size-2 slice B3/B4. The matching API page/size sequence has test source but no offered execution observation.
The service unit test asserted the entire response for tools page 3 size 2, including empty items and total 2. An API call for this boundary has no offered execution assertion.
